adopted: Treat the TICO-reference decomposition as an exact descriptive sample identity, not a causal mechanism decomposition.

Do not use magnitude dominance, percentages, or the exposed decomposition to select a new tokenizer.

result: Accepted. The observed total cross-domain fairness-gain shift is robust algebraically, but attribution is non-identifiable and partition-dependent. The later support audit confirmed that a 3-by-4 refinement has one Books-positive/TICO-empty cell and minimum nonzero TICO count one.
